summary: Iteration 4 (performance + authenticity + a11y pass) - full frontend verification against the 9 acceptance criteria. All 9 checks PASS. Backend endpoints (POST /api/contact, POST /api/donations checkout) validated end-to-end and functional. Note: dev server was serving stale index.html initially (still had lang=en, theme=#000000, duplicate meta desc, 'A product of emergent.sh'). Restarting the frontend supervisor picked up the new /app/frontend/public/index.html. Please ensure the built/served index.html is refreshed on deploy.

action_items: Non-blocking: ensure production deploy pipeline actually serves the updated /app/frontend/public/index.html. In the preview env the dev server initially served a stale HTML (lang=en, theme=#000000, duplicate 'A product of emergent.sh' meta) until 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' was run. If your CI/CD caches CRA public assets, please invalidate them or rebuild.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html changes are not always picked up by the CRA dev server if the process was started before the file was edited - a restart or clean rebuild is required. Consider documenting this in memory/PRD or the deploy scripts.
media.js correctly localizes heavy lobby PNGs to /images/*.webp (~70-75KB each) — good performance win.

Region credits are hard-coded in a parallel array (REGION_CREDITS) to REGION_KEYS order — a small refactor to key credits by region slug would prevent silent misalignment if the array order changes in the future.

Some Unsplash hero images (heroNurse w=1600 ~172KB, softLight w=1600 ~229KB) are still fairly heavy; if home LCP is a concern, consider dropping to w=1200 or serving via a CDN with automatic AVIF/WebP negotiation.

rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Only observation: index.html changes required a frontend supervisor restart. RCA: CRA dev server does not always hot-reload changes to public/index.html; the served HTML is bundled at startup. Mitigation: sudo supervisorctl restart frontend after editing public/index.html.
